definitions.explanation: Warm-blooded vertebrate animals that have hair or fur and nurse their young with milk. The class Mammalia in biological classification.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}は{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}です。
{鯨|くじら}は{魚|さかな}ではなく{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}です。
{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}は{子供|こども}に{乳|ちち}を{与|あた}えます。
examples.english: Mammals nurse their young with milk.

notes:
{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい} is a scientific classification term.

{哺乳|ほにゅう} means "nursing/lactation" and {類|るい} means "class/category."

Related animal classification terms:
- {爬虫類|はちゅうるい} (reptiles)
- {両生類|りょうせいるい} (amphibians)
- {鳥類|ちょうるい} (birds)
- {魚類|ぎょるい} (fish)

Examples of mammals:
- {犬|いぬ}、{猫|ねこ}、{熊|くま}、{象|ぞう}、イルカ、{鯨|くじら}
